raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 28
, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer supplied an incorrect upper estimate of the total penguin population (“approximately 59 million”) from Wikipedia. The correct upper estimate at the end of 2012 is higher (around the high 80–90 million range), so using 59,000,000 as the denominator led to an inflated percentage (0.00049%) instead of the correct 0.00033%.
